name: bookish-press
description: A platform for reading and writing readable, accessible, beautiful online books.

scripts.//dev: echo 'Run the Svelte/Vite local server to test locally. Use in combination with run emu to run locally.'
scripts.//emu: echo 'This copies the local .env file and starts the emulator'
scripts.emu: firebase use dev && npm run env && firebase emulators:start
scripts.//test:e2e: echo 'Build the app and run the Playwright smoke tests against a preview server.'
scripts.//test:e2e:emu: echo 'Build the app and run the Playwright suite that signs in and edits against dedicated Firebase emulators (see firebase.test.json).'
scripts.test:e2e:emu: npm run build && playwright test --config playwright.emulator.config.ts
scripts.//env: echo 'This copies the .env file corresponding to the current Firebase project specified with firebase use, defaulting to local'
scripts.//deploy:ssr: echo 'Build the app with the current .env, then deploy the SSR server in build/ to Cloud Run for the given project. Used by stage and release.'
scripts.deploy:ssr: vite build && gcloud run deploy bookish-ssr --source . --region us-central1 --allow-unauthenticated --quiet --project
scripts.//stage: echo 'Switch to the dev project, build with the dev .env, deploy the SSR server to Cloud Run, then deploy hosting, rules, and functions.'
scripts.stage: firebase use dev && cp .env.bookish-dev-21ac3 .env && npm run deploy:ssr -- bookish-dev-21ac3 && firebase deploy
scripts.//release: echo 'Switch to the prod project, build with the prod .env, deploy the SSR server to Cloud Run, then deploy hosting, rules, and functions.'
scripts.release: firebase use prod && cp .env.bookish-prod .env && npm run deploy:ssr -- bookish-prod && firebase deploy
scripts.//merge: merge dev into main, push to remote
scripts.merge: git checkout main && git merge dev && git push origin main && git checkout dev
